🎭 Basics

Turing test

In simple words

Alan Turing's 1950 test: a machine passes if people chatting with it in text can't reliably tell it from a human.

A test suggested by Alan Turing in 1950: if a person chatting in text can't reliably tell whether they are talking to a machine or a human, the machine passes.

Example. Imagine texting two mystery chat partners: one is a person, the other a computer. If you can't tell which is which, the computer has passed the Turing test.

Related words

  • Artificial intelligence (AI)Computer systems that can do tasks that usually need human intelligence.
  • ChatbotA program you can have a conversation with by typing or speaking.
  • Artificial general intelligence (AGI)A possible future AI that could learn almost any mental task a human can; it doesn't exist yet.
